AZA Annual Conference attendance or speaker listing
Director of Corporate Partnerships or Director of Development role change within 12 months
Economic-impact study published referencing tourism-bureau partnership
Capital-plan vote or bond-measure approval for zoo expansion
Sponsor-pipeline announcement or title-sponsor named in zoo annual report

LED-retrofit / back-of-house habitat lighting projects (wrong motion, wrong buyer)
Hogle Zoo (confirmed existing Brite Labs delivery — existing client)
